commander: Brigadier General Frank L. Cullin, Jr.

notes: Event date: 4 December 1944 (CMH ETO order-of-battle table for the 87th Division: Third Army assigned from 25 November and III Corps from 4 December; the atlas lists the division at Le Havre on 26 November and at Metz on 8 December). Event definition: first appearance of the 87th Division in the Western Front dataset; it comes under III Corps in Lorraine, its first corps assignment. No Green Book page was read for its first combat, so this row records the assignment only. Relationship: Third Army assigned (CMH table, 25 November); III Corps from 4 December. Location: Division command post at Metz from 8 December (atlas); no earlier place is listed after Le Havre on 26 November and St-Saëns on 30 November. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Metz. Event support: low (CMH table dates only; no narrative read). Location support: low (four days before the first atlas entry in Lorraine).
